summary: BI-3430B3A4 (slice 6 of EP-PORTFOLIO-BUDGET-WIP). PlatformDevConfig gains wipAdmissionMode (enum WipAdmissionMode: shadow|enforce, default shadow). Points-in-flight admission records every admit, warn and refuse decision on the item; it blocks autonomous starts only when the mode is enforce. Shadow first per WWMD DI-D83D9C13686B, because the live install measured every portfolio 2-15x over its allowance from idle Workrooms and unaccepted items, and enforcing at once would halt every autonomous start. Set through set_backlog_delivery_budget. Additive: a column with a default. Migration: 20260925210000_wip_admission_mode.

fields.name: wipAdmissionMode
fields.reason: Whether points-in-flight admission blocks autonomous starts (enforce) or only records what it would do (shadow). Platform configuration, not personal data.
fields.provenance: Default shadow on every install; operator-set through set_backlog_delivery_budget, which records the change.
